questions: Are you experiencing severe distress or feel that your life may be in immediate danger?
Are you having difficulty breathing?
Are you having chest pain, pressure, or tightness?
Have you fainted or nearly fainted?
Have you suddenly developed weakness or numbness on one side of your body?
Have you suddenly developed trouble speaking, understanding speech, seeing, or walking?
Have you had a seizure?
Are you confused or unusually difficult to wake?
Do you have a sudden, severe, or unusually different headache?
Are you having severe abdominal pain?
Are you vomiting blood or coughing up blood?
Are you passing black stools or large amounts of blood?
Are you bleeding heavily from any source?
Do you have a high fever or shaking chills?
Have you had a serious injury recently?
Are you experiencing severe pain anywhere?
Have you noticed a new lump, swelling, rash, or skin color change?
Have you had persistent vomiting or been unable to keep fluids down?
Have you had diarrhea or constipation that is severe or unusual for you?
Have you noticed yellowing of your skin or eyes?
Have you had a new or worsening cough?
Have you had palpitations or an unusually fast or irregular heartbeat?
Have you had painful or bloody urination?
Have you noticed a significant change in how much you urinate?
Could you be pregnant?
Have you had vaginal bleeding or pelvic pain?
Have you had sudden or severe testicular pain or swelling?
Have you had new severe back or neck pain?
Have you had unexplained weight loss or persistent night sweats?
Have you had symptoms lasting more than a few days?
Have your symptoms been getting worse?
Have you had similar symptoms before?
Do you have any diagnosed medical conditions?
Do you take prescription medicines regularly?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed any medication?
Are you allergic to any medication?
Have you used alcohol or recreational drugs recently?
Have you recently traveled, been exposed to someone ill, or had an infectious illness?
Have you had surgery or been hospitalized recently?
Have you ever had heart disease, a stroke, diabetes, cancer, or a blood-clotting problem?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute minor ischaemic stroke—a small deep (lacunar) infarction of the lentiform nucleus, most likely due to small-vessel occlusion

Alternative: Transient ischaemic attack with an incidental acute lentiform-nucleus diffusion lesion

Alternative: Embolic ischaemic stroke involving a middle cerebral artery perforating branch

Alternative: Postictal Todd paralysis with an incidental acute ischemic lesion
